short: Lord High Chancellor of Sweden who orchestrated the nation's administration and directed its foreign policy through the entire Thirty Years' War.
full:
Axel Oxenstierna (1583–1654) was one of the most formidable statesmen of the seventeenth century. As Lord High Chancellor under Gustavus Adolphus, he completely modernized the Swedish state, establishing the centralized administration, taxation, and logistics network that permitted a small, impoverished country to maintain a massive continental army.

Following the King's death at Lützen in 1632, Oxenstierna became the de facto ruler of Sweden during Queen Christina's minority. Operating directly from Germany for several years, he held the fractious Protestant alliances together, managed the vital French subsidies, and directed the overarching military strategy. His ruthless diplomatic maneuvering culminated in the Peace of Westphalia, securing Sweden's status as a European great power.
